import struct, sys, zlib
sys.path.insert(0, 'project')
sys.path.insert(0, 'dev')
from collector import Case, PRIM_INDEX
from wire import packet as wpkt, payload as wpayload
from ref import validate

MASK24 = 0xFFFFFF


def seal_like(frame):
    """Recompute ICRC (and optionally checksum) after mutating a frame."""
    f = bytearray(frame)
    # zero then recompute the IPv4 header checksum
    f[24:26] = b'\x00\x00'
    s = sum(struct.unpack('!10H', bytes(f[14:34])))
    while s >> 16:
        s = (s & 0xFFFF) + (s >> 16)
    f[24:26] = struct.pack('!H', (~s) & 0xFFFF)
    crc = bytearray(b'\xff' * 8 + bytes(f[14:len(f) - 4]))
    crc[9] = 0xFF
    crc[16] = 0xFF
    crc[18:20] = b'\xff\xff'
    crc[34:36] = b'\xff\xff'
    crc[40] = 0xFF
    f[-4:] = struct.pack('<I', zlib.crc32(bytes(crc)) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    return bytes(f)


def classify(case, rank, frame):
    c = Case(PRIM_INDEX[case['primitive']], case['mode'], case['root'],
             case['segments'], case['words'], case['capacity'],
             case['start'], 0)
    before = c.c_winv + c.c_einv + c.c_data + c.c_ack
    c.ingress(rank, frame)
    after = c.c_winv + c.c_einv + c.c_data + c.c_ack
    st = c.state_list()
    if st[26]:
        return 'wire-invalid'
    if st[27]:
        return 'endpoint-invalid'
    if st[18]:
        return 'data(%s)' % ('new' if st[22] else 'dup' if st[23]
                             else 'blocked' if st[24] else 'stale')
    return 'ack(%s)' % ('effective' if st[19] - st[28] else 'ignored')


case = dict(primitive='allreduce', mode=3, root=0, segments=4, words=2,
            capacity=4, start=0)
D = 2
base = bytearray(wpkt(1, 0, wpayload(0, 0, 1, D)))       # DATA from rank 1, p=0
ackbase = bytearray(wpkt(1, 0, ack=True))               # ACK from rank 1

tests = []


def t(name, frame, rank=1, expect=None):
    tests.append((name, rank, bytes(frame), expect))


t('canonical data', base, 1, 'data(new)')
t('canonical ack', ackbase, 1, 'ack(ignored)')
t('empty frame', b'', 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('short frame', bytes(base[:57]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('bad ethertype', seal_like(base[:12] + b'\x86\xdd' + base[14:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('bad version', seal_like(base[:14] + b'\x55' + base[15:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('ihl 0x46', seal_like(base[:14] + b'\x46' + base[15:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('ip total short', seal_like(base[:16] + struct.pack('!H', 20) + base[18:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('ip total long', seal_like(base[:16] + struct.pack('!H', 100) + base[18:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('bad protocol', seal_like(base[:23] + b'\x06' + base[24:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('flags 0x2000', seal_like(base[:20] + struct.pack('!H', 0x2000) + base[22:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('flags MF', seal_like(base[:20] + struct.pack('!H', 0x0001) + base[22:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('flags 0 (valid)', seal_like(base[:20] + struct.pack('!H', 0) + base[22:]), 1, 'data(new)')
t('bad ip checksum', base[:24] + b'\x00\x01' + base[26:], 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('bad src port', seal_like(base[:34] + b'\x12\xb8' + base[36:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('bad dst port', seal_like(base[:36] + b'\x12\xb8' + base[38:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('udp len mismatch', seal_like(base[:38] + struct.pack('!H', 30) + base[40:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('udp checksum nonzero', seal_like(base[:40] + b'\x00\x01' + base[42:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('opcode 0x05', seal_like(base[:42] + b'\x05' + base[43:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('opcode 0x11 for data len', seal_like(base[:42] + b'\x11' + base[43:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('se_m_pad nonzero', seal_like(base[:43] + b'\x01' + base[44:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('pkey wrong', seal_like(base[:44] + b'\x00\x00' + base[46:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('qpn top nonzero', seal_like(base[:46] + b'\x01' + base[47:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('apsn top 0 for data', seal_like(base[:50] + b'\x00' + base[51:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('apsn top 0x40', seal_like(base[:50] + b'\x40' + base[51:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('payload short', seal_like(base[:38] + struct.pack('!H', 26) + base[40:57] + base[61:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('trailing byte', bytes(base) + b'\x00', 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('bad icrc', base[:-1] + bytes([base[-1] ^ 1]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('wrong mac src', seal_like(base[:6] + bytes((2, 1, 0, 0, 0, 2)) + base[12:]), 1, 'endpoint-invalid')
t('wrong mac dst', seal_like(bytes((2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2)) + base[6:]), 1, 'endpoint-invalid')
t('wrong ip src', seal_like(base[:26] + bytes((10, 0, 0, 2)) + base[30:]), 1, 'endpoint-invalid')
t('wrong ip dst', seal_like(base[:30] + bytes((10, 0, 0, 102)) + base[34:]), 1, 'endpoint-invalid')
t('wrong qpn', seal_like(base[:46] + b'\x00\x00\x02\x01' + base[50:]), 1, 'endpoint-invalid')
t('host qpn target', seal_like(base[:46] + b'\x00\x00\x01\x01' + base[50:]), 1, 'endpoint-invalid')
t('other rank frame', wpkt(2, 0, wpayload(0, 0, 2, D)), 1, 'endpoint-invalid')
t('different tos (valid)', seal_like(base[:15] + b'\x40' + base[16:]), 1, 'data(new)')
t('different ttl (valid)', seal_like(base[:22] + b'\x01' + base[23:]), 1, 'data(new)')
t('different id (valid)', seal_like(base[:18] + b'\xab\xcd' + base[20:]), 1, 'data(new)')
t('psn out of K', wpkt(1, 3, wpayload(0, 3, 1, D)), 1, 'data(new)')
t('psn far out of K', wpkt(1, 100, wpayload(0, 100, 1, D)), 1, 'endpoint-invalid')

# ACK-specific rules
t('ack apsn top 0x80', seal_like(ackbase[:50] + b'\x80' + ackbase[51:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('ack aeth bad top', seal_like(ackbase[:54] + b'\x1e' + ackbase[55:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('ack aeth mismatch', seal_like(ackbase[:55] + b'\x00\x00\x05' + ackbase[58:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('ack udp len 32', seal_like(ackbase[:38] + struct.pack('!H', 32) + ackbase[40:]), 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('ack extra body', bytes(ackbase) + b'\x00' * 4, 1, 'wire-invalid')
t('ack from nonreceiver reduce', ackbase, 1, 'ack(ignored)')

bad = 0
for name, rank, frame, expect in tests:
    got = classify(case, rank, frame)
    tag = '' if got == expect else '   <<< expected %s' % expect
    if got != expect:
        bad += 1
    print('%-28s %-20s%s' % (name, got, tag))
print('failures', bad, 'of', len(tests))
PYEOF
